stem.text: A ray of green light is incident normally on a diffraction grating. Several bright spots are produced on a screen on the other side of the grating, as shown.

stem.alt: A horizontal ray of green light travels to a vertical diffraction grating and splits into three rays. The rays reach a vertical screen at three marked points, labelled bright spots. Labels: ray of green light, diffraction grating, screen, NOT TO SCALE.

stem.text: Which pair of changes could result in bright spots at exactly the same angles as previously?

A.text: Use blue light and increase the distance between the grating and the screen.

B.text: Use blue light and increase the number of lines per unit length in the grating.

C.text: Use red light and increase the distance between the grating and the screen.

D.text: Use red light and increase the number of lines per unit length in the grating.
